name: 05-valkey
title: Persistencia en Valkey
command: docker exec so1-valkey-201801391 valkey-cli PING; docker exec so1-valkey-201801391 valkey-cli HGETALL so1:201801391:system:current; docker exec so1-valkey-201801391 valkey-cli LLEN so1:201801391:ebpf:events

name: 06-ebpf
title: Prueba controlada: SIGTERM capturado por eBPF
command:
sleep 300 &
SO1_TEST_PID=$!
echo "PID de prueba: $SO1_TEST_PID"
kill -TERM "$SO1_TEST_PID"
sleep 2
docker exec so1-valkey-201801391 valkey-cli --raw LRANGE so1:201801391:ebpf:events 0 199 | jq --argjson pid "$SO1_TEST_PID" 'select(.target_pid == $pid)'

name: 07-eliminaciones
title: Eliminaciones confirmadas y registradas
command: docker exec so1-valkey-201801391 valkey-cli --raw ZREVRANGE so1:201801391:series:deletions 0 0 | jq .
